item.title: Landmine Blast Wounds Civilians Harvesting Sugarcane in Shan State
item.description: Three women harvesting sugarcane in Nawnghkio Township, Shan State, were injured after triggering a landmine in farmland recently retaken by junta forces, according to local sources, underscoring the growing danger civilians face from unexploded ordnance in former conflict zones.
